isbn_note: Not a guess from the prefix pattern alone (that was explicitly avoided in the previous pass) — this specific number, 9984003612, is one of the 5 ISBNs actually listed in OpenLibrary's merged set record (OL574971M) for the 4-volume work. It falls in the same 9984-00-XXX-X (A/S Preses nams) prefix family as Vol IV's confirmed 9984-00-457-0, and it's the only one of the 5 set ISBNs not already assigned to Vol I, II, or IV — by elimination, the strongest candidate for Vol III. Confidence held at 'medium' rather than 'good' because OpenLibrary's merged record does not explicitly bind any ISBN to 'volume 3' — this is elimination logic, not a direct statement. isbn_13 check digit computed and verified against the same algorithm that correctly reproduced Vol IV's already-confirmed isbn_13.
oclc_note: Set-level identifier shared by all 4 volumes — see SRC-MAB-I for detail. One MARC record (OpenLibrary OL574971M) covers the whole work.
lccn_note: Set-level (all 4 volumes) — see SRC-MAB-I for detail. The LC record's own notes field states "Vols. 3-4 published by Preses nams. Vol. 3-4 edited by Anita Vanaga" — direct third-party confirmation this project's volume/editor/publisher table is correct for Vol III specifically.
